title: Transport local presentations from an immersed stratum to maps into its image
statement: Let i:Z→T be an immersion of schemes, g:U→T any morphism whose pointwise image is contained in the image of i, R a monoid object in abelian pro-etale sheaves on T, and M an R-module sheaf. If i* M is locally finitely presented over i* R in the library sense (a pro-etale covering with finite free cokernel presentations), then g* M is locally finitely presented over g* R. No scheme-theoretic factorization of g through i is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 5.4.2, computed on the affine ind-etale basis of Theorem 2.3.4, and Definition 6.8.10; restriction to stratum interiors in finite-stratum induction

proof.text: Form V=U×_T Z, with projections a:V→U and b:V→Z. Pointwise image containment and the scheme pullback preimage theorem prove a surjective. It is an immersion by base change; its range is all of U and hence closed, so it is a closed immersion.

Pull the presentations on Z back along b. The monoidal composition comparisons identify the result with the module pulled back along b followed by i. The cartesian equation b i=a g and the inverse composition comparison then identify it with a* g* M over a* g* R. Apply surjective closed reflection to a, coefficient ring g* R and module g* M.
